context.goal: Prevent remaining element models from destabilizing the solver via NaN/Inf stamping

symptoms: Some element models can produce NaN/Inf (divide-by-zero, overflow, invalid params) which corrupts circuitMatrix/circuitRightSide
Even with panic-mode recovery, NaN/Inf in stamps can force matrix errors or non-convergence

changes.summary: Add stamp API sanitation (finite check + magnitude clamp) for matrix/right-side and common stamp helpers; handle r=0 in stampResistor
Guard trigger/holding currents and resistances against 0/NaN to avoid divide-by-zero producing Inf multipliers/currents
Guard resistance/current against 0/NaN and mark converged=false on invalid parameters

tradeoffs: Clamping stamp magnitudes sacrifices physical accuracy during extreme spikes but prevents matrix corruption
Marking converged=false allows panic-mode recovery and timestep backoff to engage
